scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm --parallel --filter @aaraj/api --filter @aaraj/web --filter @aaraj/contracts --if-present run dev
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @aaraj/api run db:migrate
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose --file infrastructure/local/compose.yaml --env-file infrastructure/local/.env.local up --detach --wait postgres redis-state
scripts.dev:infra:stop: docker compose --file infrastructure/local/compose.yaml --env-file infrastructure/local/.env.local stop postgres redis-state
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
